attributes.board_name: South Dakota Board of Examiners of Psychologists

rules.accepted_credit_types: Activities related to the practice of psychology that improve or maintain professional skills or refresh knowledge of governing laws, rules or ethical standards (1 CEU = 10 contact hours); the board does not name specific providers
rules.new_licensee_rule: Licensees initially licensed after the first day of the annual licensure period are exempt for that period.
rules.audit_note: Written CE report with each renewal, attaching provider certificates (except reading); keep originals for five years.
rules.notes: 1.5 CEUs (15 contact hours) per annual licensure period July 1 - June 30. Independent professional reading max 5 contact hours per year. No mandatory topics in the rule.
